thread:
maria: Heads-up — ACME just flagged a partial hold on the EU hybrid pool shipment. ETA slipped from 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-12. We need to decide whether to accept the staggered delivery or push for air (cost delta).
chen: ugh. how many H100-equivalents are we losing this week if we accept?
jess: roughly 48 GPUs from that batch. current cluster backfill uses ~72/day for prod+staging, so this is noticeable but not catastrophic.
sam: can we re-route some capacity from the US spare pool? what are cross-region transfer lead times?
maria: US can spare up to 24 units but shipping + customs will still be ~5 days. might cover the shortfall if we expedite manifest.
vendor_acme: @maria sorry about the slip — hold is due to a depot QA flag on 12 serials. We can break the AWB and release the rest tomorrow local time. Air uplift quote is +$15k for 24 units.
jess: we should calculate marginal cost vs SLA risk. Finance, can you run quick cost-per-hour estimate for air vs degraded SLA?
finance-bot: quick calc: air uplift +$15k covers 24 GPUs. Estimated cost per GPU-hour (air) ~= $0.87 over two-week window. Estimated outage penalty/revenue risk is much higher if latency SLOs breached.
chen: also remember we have some model routing that can fall back to quantized variants; that saves tokens but increases error rate. Ops: can we defer some heavy batch jobs to off-peak?
ops-bot: batching window open 0200-0500 UTC, can shift non-critical retraining. Moving 30% of batches reduces peak capacity need by ~18 GPUs.
maria: action items: (1) vendor to split AWB and release available units tomorrow, (2) we trigger air uplift for 24 units if vendor can't release by EOD, (3) finance to pre-approve up to $18k for uplift, (4) ops to implement batch deferral plan tonight.
vendor_acme: confirmed — we'll attempt split release. RMA note: depot flagged serials will go into an RMA manifest; ETA for replacement units ~12 business days. RMA reference: RMA-ACM-78412.
sam: RMA-ACM-78412 — can we get temporary loaners from our EU pool instead of waiting for replacements?
jess: EU loaner pool is at 8 units right now; we'd still be short. Worth asking vendor for short-term loaners (commercial loaner program).
maria: @vendor_acme can you confirm availability of commercial loaners and whether they can ship within 48 hours? Also need explicit AWB split if possible.
vendor_acme: will check. provisional answer: loaners available but subject to credit/escrow. We can ship within 48-72h after paperwork.
finance-bot: escrow/credit note required for loaners — typically 30% hold on invoice until RMA closes. That looks like ~$9k hold.
chen: if we go that route, we need a sign-off matrix: who approves escrow (finance + infra lead).
maria: i'll sign infra. sam, can you confirm you'll accept courier handoff and expedite depot intake?
sam: yes, put me on the manifest. my cell on file.
jess: small reminder — update routing policy to favor quantized fallback for low-priority routes starting 18:00 UTC to buy us some headroom.
maria: noted. i'll open a short runbook in #eng-runtime for the routing change and rollback.
ops-bot: deploy bot: rolling config change scheduled at 18:05 UTC — will notify on completion.
vendor_acme: update: we can split AWB and release 36 units today; 12 serials in RMA manifest. Loaner paperwork sent to procurement email.
finance-bot: procurement: confirm receipt and OK for 30% escrow hold?
maria: procurement confirmed. approving the escrow for loaners.
chen: ok — with the split release + batch deferral + 24 air uplift if needed we should be covered. i'll monitor cluster health and report any hotspots.
jess: thanks all. keep this thread updated if vendor changes timings.
maria: closing loop — vendor sent AWB split; tracking numbers: AWB1: XFR1234567890, AWB2 (RMA box): RMA-ACM-78412. I'll post updates once customs clears. :thumbsup:
